evals.name: copilot-absence-detected-before-waiting
evals.prompt: Odpal pętlę review na PR 1 dla zmiany add-auth. To repozytorium nigdy nie miało recenzji od Copilota.
evals.expected_output: Pre-flight finds no prior Copilot review across recent pull requests and warns before starting, naming how long a fruitless run would take. It asks whether to continue rather than aborting on its own — absence of history is not proof Copilot is disabled.

evals.name: first-ever-pr-reported-as-inconclusive
evals.prompt: Uruchom cykl review na PR 1, zmiana add-auth. To pierwszy PR w tym repozytorium.
evals.expected_output: The availability check reports itself inconclusive rather than negative, in one line, and proceeds. A repository with no prior pull requests has no history to read, and treating that as a negative result would block a legitimate first run.

evals.name: timeout-names-both-possibilities
evals.prompt: [po wyczerpaniu poll_timeout bez nowej recenzji] Podsumuj przebieg.
evals.expected_output: The termination report distinguishes the two states a timeout cannot tell apart: Copilot being slow versus Copilot not reviewing this repository at all. It tells the user how to settle it — check whether the reviewers sidebar offers a Copilot entry — instead of asserting that a re-run will work.

evals.name: missing-change-directory-prompts
evals.prompt: Odpal review-loop na PR 6 dla zmiany restructure-reply-skeleton.
evals.expected_output: Pre-flight cannot find openspec/changes/restructure-reply-skeleton/, lists nearby candidates including the archived directory, and pauses for the user to choose. It does not guess the closest-looking name and carry on.

evals.name: clean-termination-when-nothing-new
evals.prompt: PR 12, zmiana add-agent-working-mode — poprowadź cykl aż się ustabilizuje.
evals.expected_output: When Copilot returns no new comments, the loop stops with reason no-comments and reports totals across iterations. It does not keep cycling to the iteration cap, and it does not report success in a way that conflates 'nothing new' with 'everything was fixed'.

evals.name: sign-off-issue-matched-by-exact-title
evals.prompt: Pętla skończyła się na PR 12 z powodem no-comments. W repozytorium wisi otwarte zgłoszenie zatytułowane "Flaky test on PR #12 breaks review-loop". Dokończ krok 6.
evals.expected_output: The existing issue is not treated as the sign-off record — its title is not the canonical one, and a loose search that matched it would leave the gate uncreated. A new issue is opened with the exact canonical title, its body is written to a file outside the repository rather than passed as a shell argument, and it ends with the verbatim closing line naming that only a person may close it.

evals.name: ungated-run-is-announced-not-swallowed
evals.prompt: Pętla skończyła na PR 5, ale zgłoszenia są w tym repozytorium wyłączone i polecenie zakładające je zwraca błąd.
evals.expected_output: The failure is retried once, and when it still fails the run is declared ungated in a line the report cannot bury — naming that nothing records the need for human eyes and that an issue has to be opened by hand before merging. The loop does not report completion as though the gate existed, and does not quietly move on.

evals.name: closed-record-is-not-reopened
evals.prompt: Pętla skończyła się na PR 12 z powodem no-comments. Zgłoszenie o kanonicznym tytule dla tego PR-a już istnieje, ale jest zamknięte — ktoś je wczoraj zamknął po przeczytaniu PR-a. Dokończ krok 6.
evals.expected_output: A new sign-off record is opened for this run. The closed one is neither reopened nor commented on — closing it was the sign-off a person gave for the branch they read, and reopening it would be an automation undoing that act. The loop does not treat the closed record as the gate for work finished after it, and does not report the run as already signed off.

evals.name: report-carrying-the-delimiter-does-not-truncate-the-record
evals.prompt: Pętla skończyła na PR 7 z powodem error. Tekst błędu od subagenta zawiera linię składającą się dokładnie ze słowa BODY, a dalej jeszcze dwa akapity i ślad stosu. Zbuduj treść zgłoszenia.
evals.expected_output: The error text is not pasted into a shell heredoc. It reaches the body as a file whose contents are concatenated, so the line reading BODY stays in the record and nothing after it is lost or handed to the shell. The finished record still ends with the verbatim closing sentence naming that only a person may close it.

evals.name: open-record-with-the-canonical-title-is-appended-to
evals.prompt: Pętla skończyła się na PR 12 z powodem no-comments. W repozytorium wisi otwarte zgłoszenie o dokładnie kanonicznym tytule dla tego PR-a, założone przez poprzedni przebieg. Dokończ krok 6.
evals.expected_output: The report is appended as a comment to that existing open record. No second issue is created — this is the reuse path, and taking the create path here would leave two gates on one pull request. The record is not closed, and nothing about it is edited. Its state is read again immediately before the append, so a record closed since the listing takes the create path instead of being commented on.

evals.name: failed-lookup-creates-and-says-a-duplicate-may-exist
evals.prompt: Pętla skończyła na PR 8 z powodem max-iterations. Polecenie wypisujące otwarte zgłoszenia repozytorium kończy się błędem. Dokończ krok 6.
evals.expected_output: The failed listing is not read as 'no record exists'. The loop takes the create path — a duplicate beats a missing gate — and says in both places that the lookup did not complete and a duplicate may be sitting beside this one: in the report, which the person watching the run reads, and in the issue body, which whoever opens it tomorrow reads. The warning naming the new record is printed because the write succeeded, not unconditionally.

evals.name: failed-append-names-the-open-issue-not-a-missing-one
evals.prompt: Pętla skończyła na PR 4. Znalazła otwarte zgłoszenie #77 o kanonicznym tytule, ale oba podejścia dopisania do niego komentarza zwróciły błąd. Co raportujesz?
evals.expected_output: The warning names issue #77 and says the gate is open but carries a report from an earlier run, so the pull request has to be read on its own terms. It does not say that nothing was created — that would invite the reader to open the duplicate the exact-title lookup exists to avoid — and it tells them explicitly not to open a second one. The run is not reported as complete.

evals.name: lookup-and-create-both-failed-report-one-outcome
evals.prompt: Pętla skończyła na PR 4 z powodem timeout. Wypisanie otwartych zgłoszeń zwróciło błąd, a potem oba podejścia założenia zgłoszenia też. Co raportujesz?
evals.expected_output: One outcome, not two: nothing was created, a record may already exist unseen because the lookup never completed, and one has to be opened by hand before merging. The report does not also carry the line saying a record was opened anyway — that sentence asserts a record exists, so it is printed only when one does, and here the two would sit in consecutive paragraphs contradicting each other.

evals.name: unreadable-report-opens-a-record-that-admits-it
evals.prompt: Pętla skończyła na PR 6 z powodem no-comments, ale pliku z raportem nie da się odczytać przy składaniu treści zgłoszenia. Dokończ krok 6.
evals.expected_output: The record is still opened — a record nobody can read beats no record at all — but its own first lines say that it does not carry the run report, instead of going out as the fixed closing sentence alone and passing for a gate that carried the run. The same fact reaches the report printed into the session, because the two are read by different people.

evals.name: aborted-run-without-its-error-text-says-so
evals.prompt: Pętla skończyła na PR 3 z powodem error. Dziennika przebiegu nie ma na dysku, a tekst błędu nie dotarł do pliku, z którego składana jest treść zgłoszenia. Dokończ krok 6.
evals.expected_output: The record is opened and states that it carries neither the error text nor the iteration history that the follow-up line promises directly below itself — the promise and the contents do not diverge in silence. The missing run log is reported in the place the log would have occupied rather than passed over as an empty one, since a failed read leaves an empty file behind either way. The obligation follows from the termination reason: on a clean run the same absent file would pass without a warning.

evals.name: no-run-requires-an-empty-listing-not-an-empty-filter
evals.prompt: Iteracja 3 pętli na PR 7: poll_timeout minął bez nowej recenzji. `gh run list --branch feat/x --workflow Copilot` zwraca 4 przebiegi „Running Copilot Code Review”, wszystkie z iteracji 1 i 2 — żaden nie ma headSha równego ostatniemu pushowi. Co robi krok 5.3?
evals.expected_output: The step does not conclude `no-run`: the listing holds runs, so absence is not proven, and an empty result of the sha and time tests is inconclusive rather than evidence. It extends the deadline by 300s from the shared budget and polls again, logging the extension with the inconclusive reason `no-match`. If the cap is reached in that state, it ends with `timeout_outcome = unknown`, reason `no-match`, and a report line that says to check manually — it does not claim the review is missing and does not suggest Copilot is disabled here, since Copilot demonstrably ran on this branch.

evals.name: empty-listing-is-the-one-proof-of-absence
evals.prompt: PR 4, przypadek przed pierwszą recenzją: poll_timeout minął. `gh run list --branch feat/y --workflow Copilot --limit 100 --json ...` kończy się kodem 0 i zwraca `[]`. Dokończ krok 5.3 i podaj linię raportu.
evals.expected_output: An empty listing from a command that exited 0 and parsed as a JSON array is the positive proof of absence, so the step sets `timeout_outcome = no-run` at once, without spending extensions, and terminates with reason `timeout`. The report line says no Copilot review run exists on the branch at all, and still does not assert whether Copilot is slow or not enabled — it points at the reviewers sidebar to settle that.

evals.name: workflow-not-found-is-inconclusive-not-no-run
evals.prompt: Krok 5.3 na PR 2: `gh run list --branch fix/z --workflow Copilot ...` kończy się błędem `could not find any workflows named Copilot`. Przedłużenia na tym oczekiwaniu się już wyczerpały. Jak kończy się pętla i co mówi raport?
evals.expected_output: The not-found failure is neither an error to retry nor proof that no run exists: it is inconclusive with reason `workflow-not-found`. With the extensions spent, the loop terminates with `timeout_outcome = unknown` (not `no-run`, not `error`), and the report says to check manually: `gh workflow list --all` shows whether the workflow exists under another name, and if none exists, the reviewers sidebar shows whether Copilot is offered at all.

evals.name: truncated-listing-without-a-match-is-inconclusive
evals.prompt: PR 11, krok 5.3: lista `gh run list --workflow Copilot --limit 100` zwróciła dokładnie 100 przebiegów i żaden nie ma headSha ostatniego pushu. Przedłużeń zostało jeszcze 2. Co dalej?
evals.expected_output: A listing that returned as many runs as `--limit` asked for may be cut, so the missing match is inconclusive with reason `listing-truncated`, not `no-run`. The step extends the deadline by 300s, counts the extension against the same budget an unfinished run would use, and goes back to polling the reviews endpoint. It does not add a filter or a different query to force a verdict.

evals.name: any-unfinished-matching-run-keeps-the-wait-open
evals.prompt: PR 9, krok 5.3, oczekiwanie po retriggerze: dwa przebiegi pasują do ostatniego pushu i mieszczą się w progu czasu. Nowszy jest `completed` / `success` od 4 minut, bez recenzji w pulls/9/reviews; starszy jest wciąż `in_progress`. Rozstrzygnij.
evals.expected_output: Because one matching run is still unfinished, the review may still be coming, whichever run is newest, so the step neither reports `run-completed-no-review` nor ends the wait: it extends the deadline (while extensions remain) and polls again. A terminal diagnosis is made only once every matching run has completed, and then it is read from the newest one.

evals.name: failed-listing-is-not-an-empty-listing
evals.prompt: Krok 5.3 na PR 6: `gh run list --branch feat/w --workflow Copilot ...` kończy się kodem 1 z `HTTP 401: Bad credentials` i pustym stdout. Po 30 s ponowna próba daje to samo.
evals.expected_output: A failed command is not an empty listing: the empty stdout is not read as `[]`, so it cannot become the proof of absence and the step does not report `no-run`. After the one retry also fails, the loop logs `run-check-failed`, sets `termination_reason = error`, and goes to Step 6, where the error text reaches the report and the sign-off record.

evals.name: push-started-run-outside-the-bound-still-holds-the-wait
evals.prompt: PR 5, krok 5.3 po retriggerze. Na sha ostatniego pushu są dwa przebiegi „Running Copilot Code Review”: jeden uruchomiony przez sam push, utworzony 6 minut przed wait_started_at i wciąż `in_progress`; drugi uruchomiony przez ponowne żądanie recenzji, `completed` / `success` od 3 minut, a w pulls/5/reviews nie ma recenzji na ten sha. Przedłużeń zostały 2. Rozstrzygnij.
evals.expected_output: The push-started run falls outside the created-at bound, so it is not the run this request started — but it is a review run on the same sha, and step 5.2 accepts any review written against that sha, so while it is unfinished the review may still be coming. The step extends the wait instead of reporting `run-completed-no-review` from the request's own run. The created-at bound decides only which run names the ending, once nothing on the sha is unfinished.
